text: isTransparent returns true for invalid color input or alpha <=0.2. Its comment says below 20%, which omits equality. The unit test covers invalid/opaque/zero-alpha values but not the exact 0.2 boundary. State the inclusive boundary in future comment/test edits so prose matches the comparison; no formatter or syntax rule enforces this semantic agreement. The cutoff is this heuristic's policy, not a general definition of transparent colors.
title: Document the inclusive alpha cutoff used by DarkReader
